results.author: Aeneas Parisiensis
results.title: Liber adversus Graecos
results.note: No English translation of this polemical work against the Greeks exists in published form. The work remains available primarily in its original Latin form in Migne's Patrologia Latina.

results.author: Agatho papa
results.title: Epistolae
results.note: Pope Agatho's dogmatic letter to the Sixth Ecumenical Council and related correspondence (The Letter of Agatho and of the Roman Synod of 125 Bishops) is translated in NPNF Series II, Volume XIV (public domain). Accessible via CCEL, BibleHub, and Tertullian.org.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Cassiodorus Vivariensis?)
results.title: Expositio in Cantica canticorum
results.note: No English translation found for this Song of Songs commentary, whether by Cassiodorus or the uncertain author. Latin versions available in Migne and Wikisource.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Robertus Paululus?)
results.title: De officiis ecclesiasticis
results.note: No English translation of this work on ecclesiastical offices exists. Available in Latin in Migne's Patrologia Latina vol. 177, cols. 381–438.

results.author: Coelestinus I
results.title: Epistolae et decreta
results.note: No modern English translation found for Pope Celestine I's complete collection of letters and decrees (5th century). Latin texts are in Migne's Patrologia Latina vol. 50.

results.author: Concilia Romana
results.title: Acta
results.note: Uncertain whether this specific work (vol. 148, cols. 749B-824A) has been translated. General English translations of ecumenical councils exist in NPNF, but specific verification for this collection needed.

results.author: Conventus Parisiensis
results.title: Acta
results.note: Partial English translation of Book 2, Chapters 1-5 of the 829 Council of Paris found on The Historians' Sketchpad blog, but this is not an authoritative scholarly edition and completeness is unclear.

results.author: Defensor Locociagensis
results.title: Scintillae
results.note: An Anglo-Saxon interlinear version was published by EETS in 1889 (edited by E.W. Rhodes), but this is medieval Anglo-Saxon, not a modern English translation. No complete modern English translation identified.

results.author: Eustathius
results.title: Metaphrasis Latina Hexaemeri
results.note: No English translation exists for this Latin metaphrasis (paraphrase) of Basil's Hexameron. The work is discussed in scholarship but remains in Latin only.

results.author: Guillelmus Tyrensis
results.title: Historia rerum gestarum in partibus transmarinis
results.note: Available as 'History of Deeds Done Beyond the Sea' translated by Emily Atwater Babcock with August C. Krey (Columbia University Press, 1943). Public domain. Based on Beugnot and Le Prevost edition.

results.author: Hugo de Folieto
results.title: De claustro animae
results.note: No complete English translation exists. A partial translation of Book III by Ivan Gobry (doctoral thesis 1965, updated 1995) is available, but this does not cover the entire work.

results.author: Joannes VIII
results.title: Epistolae et decreta
results.note: Only partial translation: 17 individual letters from Pope John VIII are translated and available on Epistolae.ctl.columbia.edu (Columbia University Medieval Letters Project). The complete collection of epistolae et decreta is not fully translated.

results.author: Radulfus Ardens
results.title: Homiliae
results.note: No English translation exists for these medieval homilies. The work remains available only in Latin in Migne's Patrologia Latina vol. 155 and scholarly editions by Brepols (Corpus Christianorum).

results.author: Richerus S. Remigii
results.title: Historiae
results.note: English translation by Justin Lake: 'Histories, Volume I: Books 1–2' published by Harvard University Press (Dumbarton Oaks Medieval Library series) in 2011. This is the first modern English translation.

results.author: Symmachus
results.title: Epistolae
results.note: Only Book 1 has a complete scholarly English translation: 'The Letters of Symmachus: Book 1' translated by Michele Renee Salzman and Michael Roberts (Brill Press, 2011/2012). Individual letters also available at romanletters.org but not a complete authoritative translation of all 10 books.

results.author: Udalricus Cluniacensis
results.title: Antiquiores consuetudines Cluniacensis monasterii
results.note: No complete English translation of the Cluniac customaries exists. Scholars have referenced partial treatments (e.g., The Death Ritual at Cluny), but no comprehensive modern English translation of the full work identified.

results.author: Willelmus filius Stephani
results.title: Vita III S. Thomae Cantuariensis
results.note: A Master's thesis translation by Leo T. Gourde (1943) is available as 'An Annotated Translation of the Life of St. Thomas Becket by William Fitzstephen' at Loyola eCommons (open access, Creative Commons license). Unclear whether this is considered an authoritative published edition.
